result.Method of Attack: Exploits setup.py to silently collect system information (MAC address, hostname, username, current directory) and sends base64-encoded data to remote attacker-controlled servers; uses custom setuptools installation override to run malicious payload post-installation
result.Impacted Systems: Developer systems installing Python packages from PyPI
result.Attack Vector: Malicious Python packages installed via PyPI with overridden setup.py install scripts
